items.title: AI infrastructure selloff becomes a broad market correction
items.summary: Selling spread from AI infrastructure into the broader equity market, with the Nasdaq closing in correction territory. The decline establishes widespread repricing, while potential construction restrictions and financing pressures remain risks to future infrastructure spending.
items.key_finding: The Nasdaq closed in correction territory as AI-related selling spread across the wider market.

sources.title: Portfolio Terminal — November 5, 2026 closing index data

items.title: Oil rebounds while Hormuz shipping uncertainty persists
items.summary: Crude recovered part of the previous session's sharp losses as shipping threats kept supply risks in focus. The rebound does not establish safer transit or restored oil flows, and the scout's quoted prices are retained as late-trading observations.
items.key_finding: Oil's rebound signals renewed supply-risk pricing; improved physical shipping conditions remain unestablished.

sources.title: Reuters via Investing.com — November 5, 2026 oil and tanker-risk report

items.title: AppLovin demonstrates exceptional relative strength
items.summary: AppLovin rose against the technology rout after reporting rapid revenue growth, substantial free cash flow and a larger repurchase authorization. Its earnings-backed strength stands out, though sustaining advertising growth and meeting valuation expectations remain risks.

observations.label: Share-repurchase authorization increase
observations.value: $3.2 billion, bringing total authorization to $3.6 billion

items.key_finding: Strong reported earnings supported exceptional relative strength during the broader technology selloff.
